summary: The proposal defines two categories of format changes—add‑everywhere and compatibility level—to speed up feature rollout while keeping readers safe. Andrew Lamb opens a discussion to gather contributors for adding new encodings to Parquet. The discussion centers on adding a logical VECTOR type to Parquet, using metadata fields to encode length constraints and potentially finite element restrictions. Participants debate whether to enforce finiteness and whether to separate VECTOR from FIXED_LENGTH_LIST, ultimately agreeing to introduce a logical type first and refine physical representation later.
